heading: Submission of report by Chief of Engineers
lead: It is declared to be the policy of the Congress that the following provisions shall be observed: No project or any modification not authorized, of a project for flood control or rivers and harbors, shall be authorized by the Congress unless a report for such project or modification has been previously submitted by the Chief of Engineers, United States Army, in conformity with existing law.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section comprises last two paragraphs of section 202 of act Sept. 3, 1954. First paragraph of section 202 is set out as a note under section 701–1 of this title.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in the following prior acts: May 17, 1950, ch. 188, title II, § 202, 64 Stat. 170. June 30, 1948, ch. 771, title II, § 202, 62 Stat. 1175. July 24, 1946, ch. 596, § 2, 60 Stat. 641.
